title: Just Turned Eighteen
story: The ticket booth turns away exactly-eighteen-year-olds. Chilaka insists the rule is right.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: Test the boundary: what does is_adult(18) give?
Is 18 over eighteen, or eighteen and over?
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?

parrot.says: Squawk! Adults are people OVER eighteen. Rules are rules!

diagnose.question: Which statement explains the bug?
options: > is false for exactly 18, but 18-year-olds are adults
diagnose.why: The rule is 18 or older, so the comparison must be >= 18.
